output.summary: A flowering plant native from Central Asia west through Europe and south into Southwest Asia and North Africa. It is thin and much-branched, with small yellow, dandelion-like flowers. On Crete, leaves and tender shoots of a local variety are eaten raw or boiled in salads.
output.edibilityNote: On Crete, leaves and tender shoots of a local variety are eaten raw or boiled; the plant is also traditionally eaten in southern Italy.
